user.title: RuiXin lights
user.description: Lights are controlled by BLE advertisements (not GATT). The Home Assistant host needs a Bluetooth adapter, or MQTT plus tools/mqtt_ble_advertiser.py next to the lamp.

deli_mode.title: Pairing
deli_mode.description: Pairing is one-way BLE advertise (cmd 0xB4, payload AA 66 55). Put the lamp in learn mode. There is no ACK — you confirm whether it reacted. Rolling code is shared by every ceiling light on this Home Assistant; destId is 1–15.

deli_pair_info.title: Ready to pair
deli_pair_info.description: Put the lamp in learn mode (wall switch off/on, or power on). It often flashes quickly. Then continue — Home Assistant will advertise for about 1 second (HFKJ + DLKJ × 5). Rolling {rolling}, destId {dest_id}.

deli.title: Already paired
deli.description: Paste the 4-byte rolling code sniffed from the phone app (scanner decode). Do not pair again or the phone will stop working.

pair_confirm.title: Did the lamp react?
pair_confirm.description: The app never gets an ACK. If the lamp flashed, stayed on, or beeped, pairing worked. destId {dest_id}, rolling {rolling}.

pair_failed.title: Could not advertise
pair_failed.description: The pairing frame was not sent. Fix Bluetooth/MQTT and retry, or save the device and use the Pair button later.

mesh.title: Mesh device id
mesh.description: First 6 hex characters of the mesh device id (e.g. AABBCC).

adapter.title: Bluetooth adapter
adapter.description: Local HCI adapter used to transmit. HAOS needs the adapter on the host, not only a Bluetooth proxy (proxies cannot advertise).

mqtt.title: MQTT advertiser
mqtt.description: Home Assistant publishes a JSON burst to this topic. Run tools/mqtt_ble_advertiser.py (or the ESPHome example) on a machine that can BLE-advertise next to the lamp.

error.invalid_rolling: Rolling code must be 4 bytes (8 hex characters).
error.invalid_dev_id: Device id needs at least 6 hex characters.
error.advertise_failed: Could not send BLE advertisements. Check the adapter, or switch to MQTT.
Could not send BLE advertisements. Check the adapter, or switch to MQTT.

data.pair_now: Re-pair now (put the lamp in learn mode first)
data.unpair_now: Delete pairing now (0xB0) and remove this device
